summary: Detailed implementation plan for building three core production modules: Collections & Receivables Aging (FIFO buckets, payment receipts, statement of accounts), Analytics & Tile Financial Reports (Sq.Ft velocity, P&L, fast/slow shades, architect commissions), and E-Invoice & GST Compliance Center (IRN/QR generation, E-Way bills, HSN 6907 audit) with a strict zero-demo-data policy and full mobile/tablet responsiveness.
